title: Luxuriant Ukrainian Mozzarella Casserole
description: A nutty and molten Ukrainian dish featuring mozzarella and bhuna, perfect for a special occasion, this low-sodium casserole is cooked to perfection in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the bhuna sauce, flour, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef mixture and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Spoon the mixture into 6 ramekins, filling them to the top.
Place the ramekins on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the ramekins from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F.
